name: Thomas Harrington
original_name: トマス ハリントン
source:
An obese doctor who is a longtime acquaintance of [url=/c95250]Jacob[/url]. 

It appears that although he knows about the secrets of Shironagasu Island, he's doing his utmost best to make sure that they will never see the light of day.

[From [url=https://tabinomichi.jp/shironagasu/en/]official website[/url]]
